title: Implement @aiflow/crypto AES-256-GCM
description: Replace the empty stub in `packages/crypto` with a real leaf package (Node `crypto` only — no Prisma). Public surface in `packages/crypto/src/index.ts`: `encrypt(plaintext: string, key?: Buffer): EncryptedEnvelope`, `decrypt(envelope: EncryptedEnvelope, key?: Buffer): string`, `readEncryptionKey(): Buffer`. Key policy (SPEC assumption #1): `process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY` must be exactly **32 UTF-8 bytes**; throw a clear error if missing/wrong length. Envelope shape: `{ __encrypted__: string }` where the string is Base64 of `iv(12) || authTag(16) || ciphertext` (document byte layout in JSDoc). Algorithm: AES-256-GCM. Split into `encrypt.ts` / `key.ts` if needed to stay ≤200 lines / fn ≤50. Ensure TypeScript builds via existing `typecheck` script. Consumers will wrap results with `asEncryptedValue` from `@aiflow/db` — do not depend on `@aiflow/db` from this package.
acceptance: `@aiflow/crypto` exports encrypt, decrypt, readEncryptionKey; round-trip works with a 32-byte key; wrong-length ENCRYPTION_KEY throws; package has no Prisma/deps beyond Node builtins; `yarn workspace @aiflow/crypto typecheck` succeeds.

title: Test @aiflow/crypto round-trip
description: Add Vitest tests under `packages/crypto` (e.g. `src/crypto.test.ts` or `src/index.test.ts`). Wire a test script if the package lacks one so root `yarn test` picks it up (match monorepo vitest pattern used by other packages). Cover: (1) encrypt→decrypt round-trip restores plaintext; (2) wrong key fails decrypt; (3) truncated / non-32-byte `ENCRYPTION_KEY` rejected by `readEncryptionKey`; (4) malformed envelope (missing tag, bad base64, short buffer) rejected. Set `ENCRYPTION_KEY` in test setup to a fixed 32-char string. No network. Keep ≤200 lines.
acceptance: `yarn test` runs crypto tests; round-trip, wrong key, truncated key, and malformed envelope cases pass; `yarn verify` green for this package path.

title: Align ModelConfigValue envelope types
description: Update `packages/db/src/config-types.ts` so `ModelConfigValue` matches SPEC: the **entire** logical JSON blob is stored as a single `EncryptedValue` envelope in `ModelConfig.config` (not `{ model, config: EncryptedValue }`). Logical plaintext before encrypt: `{ analyst: { provider, model, baseURL?, apiKey? } }`. Keep `EncryptedValue` + `asEncryptedValue` unchanged. Export any helper types needed by web (e.g. `AnalystModelConfigPlain`) if useful, or document the shape in JSDoc only. Update comments referencing the old scaffolding shape; briefly align related notes in `docs/03` / code-map encryption line if they still describe the nested form (SPEC assumption #14/#20). No Prisma migration required — column stays Json.
acceptance: `ModelConfigValue` is the encrypted envelope of the analyst blob; `asEncryptedValue` still guards `__encrypted__`; old nested `{ model, config }` type is gone; package typecheck passes.

title: ModelConfig feature service
description: Create FSD slice `apps/web/src/features/model-config` with `model/service.ts` (+ types), barrel `index.ts`. Depend on `@aiflow/crypto`, `@aiflow/db` (`getProjectClient`, `asEncryptedValue`), soft-delete filter `deletedAt: null`. Functions: `getAnalystModelConfig(schemaName)` → public DTO `{ provider, model, baseURL, hasApiKey }` + `source: 'project' | 'env'` (never plaintext key; on missing row or decrypt fail → env hints via `readProviderConfigFromEnv()`); `upsertAnalystModelConfig(schemaName, projectId, input)` — validate non-empty provider/model; if `apiKey` omitted/null/'' without clear → keep previous key; if `clearApiKey: true` → rewrite blob without key; encrypt whole JSON via `encrypt` then `asEncryptedValue`; upsert by `projectId`. Providers MVP: `openai` | `routerai`. Keep files ≤200 / fn ≤50. Add `@aiflow/crypto` workspace dependency on `@aiflow/web` if missing.
acceptance: Barrel exports get/upsert helpers; GET shape never includes apiKey; upsert encrypts full config blob; clearApiKey removes project key; soft-delete filter applied; `yarn verify` green.

title: ModelConfig GET and PUT API routes
description: Add thin App Router handlers (logic only in feature): `GET` and `PUT` at `apps/web/src/app/api/projects/[id]/model-config/route.ts`. Gate: `requireUser()` → Pro check (`uiMode !== 'PRO'` → 403 JSON Russian) → owner/project access (`deletedAt: null`) → 404 if missing. GET → 200 SPEC shape `{ analyst, source }`. PUT body `{ analyst: { provider, model, baseURL?, apiKey? }, clearApiKey? }` → 400 validation, 500 if ENCRYPTION_KEY invalid, 200 same as GET. Never log or return plaintext keys. Wiring only in `app/`.
acceptance: GET/PUT match SPEC; BASIC → 403; non-owner → 404; plaintext key never in responses; `yarn verify` green.

title: Chat and SPEC resolve ModelConfig
description: Update existing `POST /api/projects/[id]/chat` and specifications generation path so before calling the LLM they resolve Analyst config: (1) load+decrypt project ModelConfig; (2) if analyst apiKey present → `createOpenAICompatibleProvider({ baseURL, apiKey, chatModel })` and use ModelConfig model; (3) else `createProviderFromEnv()` / `readProviderConfigFromEnv()`. Prefer a small shared helper in `features/model-config` (e.g. `resolveAnalystProvider(schemaName)`) to avoid duplicating logic. Embeddings/RAG stay on env (SPEC). Do not touch model-router wiring. Keep routes thin; no secrets in logs.
acceptance: Chat and SPEC generation use project ModelConfig when key present, else env fallback; embeddings unchanged on env; no plaintext keys logged; `yarn verify` green.

title: Model settings page and Pro nav
description: Add page `apps/web/src/app/(app)/projects/[id]/settings/models/page.tsx` — wiring: `requireUser` + `requireProMode` + project access; render UI from `features/model-config/ui`. Form (Russian): heading «Модель Analyst»; select provider (`openai`/`routerai`); inputs model, optional baseURL, password apiKey (empty + «Ключ сохранён (••••)» when hasApiKey; empty save = keep; Button «Удалить ключ» → clearApiKey); Save; status text for project vs env; toast success/error; loading Spinner, error+«Повторить», saving disabled. SideMenu / project nav: Pro-only «Настройки модели» → this URL. Add `@source` in `globals.css` for the new feature dir if needed. Primitives from `@aiflow/ui`; files ≤200 lines.
dependencies: ModelConfig GET and PUT API routes
acceptance: `/projects/[id]/settings/models` works for Pro owners; BASIC redirected; menu link Pro-only; save/clear key UX matches SPEC; Tailwind classes apply; `yarn verify` green.

title: Implement @aiflow/queue package
description: Replace empty `packages/queue` stub with real BullMQ helpers. Export: queue name constants for all four (`spec:generate`, `plan:generate`, `code:execute`, `deploy:run`) for compose `QUEUES=` compatibility; Redis connection factory from `REDIS_URL` (or existing env); `getDeployQueue()`; typed `DeployRunPayload` `{ projectId, deploymentId, schemaName, giteaOwner, giteaRepo, giteaDefaultBranch }`; default job options (limited attempts for infra; build failures fail-fast — document attempts: 1 for deploy build errors). App is producer-only; no workers here. Keep package ≤200 lines per file; leaf aside from bullmq/ioredis (already in package.json).
acceptance: `@aiflow/queue` exports four queue names, connection factory, getDeployQueue, DeployRunPayload type; typecheck passes; no dockerode dependency.

title: Deploy templates and export API
description: Create `features/deploy` (or templates under it): `Dockerfile.tmpl` + `docker-compose.yml.tmpl` — minimal Node 22 / Next-compatible single `app` service, image name `aistudio-project-{shortId}`, port 3000. Service: `renderDeployTemplates(project)` and `exportDeployTemplates(ctx, { commitToGitea })` using `@/shared/gitea` Contents API to write `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` on default branch with message `chore: add deploy templates (AI Studio)`. Route: `POST /api/projects/[id]/deploy/export` — Pro+owner; body `{ commitToGitea?: boolean }` default true; 200 `{ dockerfile, compose, committed, commitSha? }`; 404 if no gitea fields (hint open editor for provision); 502 Gitea. Next.js must not call dockerode. Files ≤200 / fn ≤50.
acceptance: Export returns rendered texts; commitToGitea true writes both files to Gitea; false returns texts only; Pro/owner gates enforced; `yarn verify` green.

title: Deployments create list and detail APIs
description: In `features/deploy` + thin routes: (1) `POST /api/projects/[id]/deployments` — Pro+owner; optional `{ exportFirst?: true }` default true → always re-export/overwrite templates then: if any Deployment/DeploymentMeta status BUILDING for project → 409; create `Deployment` (project schema) and `DeploymentMeta` (public) with **same uuid**, status BUILDING, url null, initial log; `getDeployQueue().add('deploy:run', payload)` — **no dockerode in apps/web**; return 202 `{ deploymentId, status: 'BUILDING' }`; errors 403/404/409/502/503. (2) `GET .../deployments` — owner BASIC+PRO; array without full log, `createdAt desc`. (3) `GET .../deployments/[deploymentId]` — owner; full object including log; 404. Soft-delete filters. Depend on queue + export helpers.
acceptance: POST enqueues deploy:run and creates paired Deployment/Meta ids; second BUILDING → 409; GET list/detail match SPEC; apps/web has zero dockerode imports; `yarn verify` green.

title: Worker deploy:run dockerode consumer
description: Implement `apps/worker` BullMQ consumer for queue `deploy:run` only (other queues may remain no-op stubs). Add `dockerode` dependency to **apps/worker only** (MIT — note in JSDoc / §8). Handler steps: validate payload; clone repo via git + token URL `http://oauth2:TOKEN@gitea:3000/...` into `/tmp/deploy-{deploymentId}` (or worker_temp); `dockerode.buildImage` with tag `aistudio/{giteaRepo}:{shortSha|timestamp}`; stream build output appending to `Deployment.log` periodically; on success set status DEPLOYED, `imageTag`, stub `url` like `local://image/{imageTag}` (build-only MVP — container start optional); on failure FAILED + message in log; sync `DeploymentMeta`; delete temp dir. Job attempts: fail-fast on build errors. **docker.sock is DEV-ONLY** (OQ #4): update compose comment on `/var/run/docker.sock` mount to say dev-only; document in worker JSDoc that prod needs remote Docker/TLS/K8s Jobs — do not implement Vault/Swarm; on `ENVIRONMENT=prod` without remote `DOCKER_HOST` log a warning (no hard-fail required). Next.js must never import dockerode.
dependencies: Deployments create list and detail APIs
acceptance: Worker processes deploy:run with dockerode; success→DEPLOYED+stub url, failure→FAILED; log streams; temp cleaned; compose sock mount commented as dev-only; no dockerode in apps/web; `yarn workspace @aiflow/worker typecheck` succeeds.
